items.markdown:
Find free and low-cost printable Christmas games for family gatherings, office parties, and kids' activities through collections like [Flanders Family Home Life](https://www.flandersfamily.info/web/tag/christmas-game/) and [Pjs and Paint](https://pjsandpaint.com/printables/free-printable-christmas-games-and-activities/).[[1]](https://www.flandersfamily.info/web/tag/christmas-game/)[[2]](https://pjsandpaint.com/printables/free-printable-christmas-games-and-activities/)

### Popular Printable Game Categories

- **Trivia & Quizzes:** Christmas movie trivia, Christmas IQ, name-that-tune song quizzes, and "Who Said What".
- **Word & Puzzle Games:** Holiday word searches, Christmas word scrambles, crosswords, Boggle boards, and Scattergories.
- **Icebreakers & Party Games:** Finish the phrase ("What's Rudolph Thinking?"), "What's on Your Phone," Christmas Bingo (including Grinch Bingo), and Left-Right passing gift games.
- **Kids & Family Activities:** Roll-a-Snowman dice games, I Spy sheets, coloring pages, matching games, and indoor holiday scavenger hunts.[[1]](https://ca.pinterest.com/sandrat01/printable-christmas-games/)[[2]](https://www.flandersfamily.info/web/tag/christmas-game/)[[3]](https://allthepartyideas.com/printable-christmas-games/)[[4]](https://pjsandpaint.com/printables/free-printable-christmas-games-and-activities/)[[5]](https://www.partygamesnow.com/printable-christmas-games/)[[6]](https://foxfarmhome.com/printable-christmas-games/)[[7]](https://www.kitchencounterchronicle.com/20-free-printable-christmas-games-for-the-whole-family/)

### Where to Download Ready-Made Bundles

- **Free Printables:** Check sites like [Fox Farm Home](https://foxfarmhome.com/printable-christmas-games/) for simple multi-game sets or [Activity Village](https://www.activityvillage.co.uk/printable-christmas-games) for younger kids.
- **Paid Bundles:** For comprehensive illustrated packs with answer keys, check curated options like the [CherryLittleDesignCo Christmas Bundle on Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/listing/1591093532/christmas-games-bundle-christmas-party).[[1]](https://www.etsy.com/listing/1591093532/christmas-games-bundle-christmas-party)[[2]](https://foxfarmhome.com/printable-christmas-games/)[[3]](https://www.activityvillage.co.uk/printable-christmas-games)

If you let me know **who is playing (kids, adults, or a mix)** and **what kind of setting** you are hosting for, I can recommend specific games or themes.
